Bill.BriefDescription: Financing hospitals by the health care facilities authority.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to financing hospitals by the health carefacilities authority; and adding a new section to chapter 70.37 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.37 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The total amount of outstanding indebtedness of the authoritywith respect to hospital projects may not exceed five billion fivehundred million dollars at any time. (2) For purposes of this section, the calculation of outstandingindebtedness must include the initial principal amount of an issue andmay not include interest that is either currently payable or thataccrues as a part of the face amount of an issue payable at maturity orearlier redemption. Outstanding indebtedness does not include notes orbonds as to which the obligation of the authority has been satisfiedand discharged by refunding or for which payment has been provided byreserves or otherwise.
